reviews.title: Low Cost Airlines with Premium Price on many routes
reviews.text: Since 2020, I have love and hate affairs with Nok Air on regular basis. As my job demand me to fly to many locations such as Buriram, Chiangmai, Chiangrai, Chumphon, Hatyai, Lampang, Loei, Mae Sot, Nakhon Sri Thammarat, Ranong, Surat Thani, Phuket, Udon Thani, and Ubon Ratchatani. So, I ended up flew Nok Air more than another available airlines in Thailand domestic sercies. The positive side, Nok Air tends to have one of the best coverage throughout Thai airports. If you have to travel to certain provinces, Nok Air is one of the airline that came out of your mind that they will fly there. Especially remote provinces. Average side: Seat comfort is better than many low cost airline. Larger seat. But old and not very well maintained. Average leg room, better than some low cost airlines. No entertainment in the same manner with other airlines. So-so customer services. Apart from lucky draw for customers to fill in during 2021, nothing fancy came up to my mind. On highly competitive flights, they are value for money. Their plane is probably the cleanest among low cost carriers. Prior to covid19, they tend to have some hot food as a complimentary. Now I did not see them until today. Negative side of this airline: Check in and boarding services are as bad as any low cost airlines. But the worst part is the lack of concern over the passengers who have to depart but may stuck with some of the airport security. I have to admit that Don Muang Airport is one of the worst airport in security check timing and management. I used to stuck between 30-60 minutes just to pass security check up. The queue management is horrible. Nokair can help their passengers, who may stuck in those process by indicating to the airport officers for special needed. But that's never happen. I missed 2 flights from my last year one to Lampang another to Chiangrai due to the waiting time for security check. Also, the airlines tend not to inform their customer, if their flight time is changing. The worst part of this airline is their ticket pricing. In a high competitive routes such as Chiangmai, Phuket, Hat Yai, Khon Kaen, Udon Thani, etc. You may not notice the differences. BUT if you have to travel to unique location where Nokair held monopoly or duopoly, prepare for the worst. The destination such as Lampang, Loei, Ranong, Chumphon, Mae Sot, Mae Hongsorn, Betong. Their ticket price can be as expensive as any full service airlines (in some case, even more than international flights). The location that you need to travel on Bombardier Q400 propeller aircrafts. That is the sign of hefty price on your ticket prices. For duopoly location such as Lampang, Loei; you better check with their competitor as well. If there is a full service competing on the same route, just pay extra for full service airline. Flight cancellation is possible for this airlines. I've got 2 cancellation during the 2021, one to Mae Sot (where they have monopoly). I have to book Bangkok Airways to Sukhothai and rent a car to drive to Mae Sot which is 2 hours drive to my original destination). Another is Chumphon, which led to me get my colleague to drop me off at Surat Thani and catching another airlines home. Another case is Betong, which I and my team planned to travel but luckily Nokair cancel that flight before we finalize our booking. So, travelling with Nokair is adventurous. Flight cancellations are possible. For some of my case such as Lampang. Nokair offered a flight from Chiangmai plus bus services from Lampang to Chiangmai for their customers. So, they do take responsibilities on many cases. Generally, they are average airline that you can travel with.

reviews.title: DON'T RECOMMEND
reviews.text: Dear Nok Air Team, I am contacting you to express my dissatisfaction with my flight on July 16, 2022 on flight DD527. My partner and I arrived at the airport more than 4 hours early, we checked in early, and waited for your staff to board the plane, with a lot of delay. When we bought our ticket, we had taken an option for our luggage, which we paid for. Once on board your staff, very very disrespectfully, ordered us to give our two travel bags to put them in the hold. We refuse and explain that we have electronic equipment that is fragile and cannot be put in the hold. I will skip the verbal fight that took place between us and not one but 3 of your hostesses who ordered us to give our bags without letting us explain ourselves. Our bags are not suitcases and the equipment inside is very valuable and therefore not protected by a cover, hence the importance for us to have taken this option. Especially when we see the compensation you get in case of loss or damage of one of the luggage, it was out of question for us to take this risk. We paid for this option to be able to travel serenely, but this was not the case, due to the lack of professionalism of your team. Cabin suitcases could have been taken out of the luggage racks and put in the hold, but your hostesses refused, telling us that we had to board the plane earlier. Who are they kidding? How dare they tell us that while we were in the queue and YOUR COMPANY was late? Are we supposed to jump over people to get on the plane on time according to the wishes of your hostesses? Seeing the delay growing, your hostesses then asked us to keep our bags at our feet (??????). Yes, OUR FEET. How can an airline and even worse, stewardesses trained on safety standards order you to keep bags of 7kg each at your feet. Do I have to remind you that the area at your feet must be cleared during an emergency evacuation? This is simply shameful. You will find attached pictures of the way your crew dared to make us travel. To finish, I come not only to tell you the facts which for me are intolerable but also and especially to claim the refund of the baggage option that we paid and which we did not benefit from.

reviews.title: Never Fly This Airline - Inacceptable method of gathering customers
reviews.text: Deeply disappointed and highly upset about their marketing system. Due to a Personal Occasion, I was searching for a flight that gets me to Phitsanulok (a Province some hundred Miles north of Capital Bangkok. When I opened the Search Engine (traveligo.com) I was provided with a variety of flights of multiple Airlines. But Nok Air was standing out with its selection of Flights. Consequentially, I find the most suitable time at Nok Air and made the booking, pay the money and received my Confirmation, everything fine so far. What happened next, few days (I can't remember but probably even few weeks) later, it all started. I received the First notification that my flight (To Destination) has been cancelled, and I should contact them. Okay, never had it before (nothing urgent happened, such as COVID-19 Lockdown or else neither), but maybe it may happen sometimes. Anyway, contact them, rearranged Flight schedule. Have to change plans, rearrange Pick up time at Airport, and and and. But okay, everything okay, it may happen once in lifetime. Then, another day (another week later if I remember right). I receive another SMS notification, announcing the Flight I have changed to has been cancelled again, please contact "1318". Quite annoying, have other things to do besides rearranging my Flights every time. Call "1318", the Associate adds on that even my Flights back (So Back and forth) got cancelled. At this moment, it is super annoying, I just had a busy day at work and am really not in mood to Deal with that mentally. As a consequence, I make a mistake and somehow tell the Lady, or confirm a Flight offered by her, what is on the next day, I need to appear in work. If it was me who said the wrong date, I confess my own mistake. But, the circumstances that lead to finally letting me make the mistake does so much anger me that much. Anyway, the day before my flight to destination, I recognize that I have actually booked a wrong date for my way back, immediately contact Contact Center. Nok Air blames me that I have confirmed this schedule, it is my fault, hence they cannot cancel, arranging schedule back to original date can be made for Additional Fee (They offered me to change for free after a while, but anyway do not have a time I can fly). After half day of complaining (I could use this time to prepare my travel on next day) and asking them to arrange a Compensation Flight by another Airline, their answer that it is my fault that I confirmed the Flight on a wrong day, so that is not their business. The only option is to change my flight (Free of Charge but only for a time I cannot fly) with Nok Air, or Option 2 send me a voucher with exact same value as I paid for the Flight back and amend reservation. Both not an option suiting me, as I cannot fly at this time and I will never fly with you again, so I cannot use a voucher. Finally after Half day literally arguing, they Finally accept Refunding me (not voucher), but now I have to search for another flight one day before departing. So much about my experience this time. <Conclusion> Maybe it's not their purpose, so I don't want to assume it, but what I suspect after all this is, that it is Nok Air's method to gather more customers. From the very beginning they do plan to cancel a majority of Flights. The more offering Flights, the more chance to gather more customers (especially on a low season day). That is attractive, every Guest have their own preference, some needs to fly early to be attend a business meeting, some maybe prefer a flight later. The more schedules you offer, the more chances is rising to get more customers choosing your Airline. Customer chooses you and settles money. Once you have gathered enough to put on 1 Flight, you start cancelling Flights and merge them into 1. You have a complex refunding policy (takes 45 business days, and they have to get it through Travel Agency and cannot confirm that they will refund), so the convenient option what is: "Accept their remai

I had to go to the ticket selling counter. Where the staff was extremely rude to me, called me a liar and denied me a boarding pass even though it was then 45 mins before my flight. They would not refund my ticket or give me another ticket for another flight. Again, I checked in online almost 3 hours before my flight. The app confirmed I was checked in, but never sent me the boarding pass. I arrived at the airport 50 mins before my flight, and there was no available staff at the check-in. I was denied service, called a liar, and Nok Air and its rude incompetent staff stole from me.
reviews.author: Robert Steven W

reviews.title: This is the equivalent to Spirit airlines in USA
reviews.text: I’m sorry to say, but Nok air is like Spirit airlines in the US. They nickel and dime for everything so that’s how the fares are so cheap. We originally, had bought air flights to Vietnam from Bangkok but when we arrived to check in our bags, they told us we couldn’t go because we don’t have a visa to get in. Ok, so we get on the phone with them and they agreed to give us a partial refund but come to find out they lied and never did! I do not recommend or will I ever use nok air again!
reviews.author: KatPanyanouvong
